canonical_project: JT Rue Des Pres Data Centre
notes: Official JT product description identifies the Rue Des Pres facility as a Tier 3 data centre with dual 1.5 MVA transformers, 4x550 kVA generators, 2x800 kVA UPS units, 840 kW cooling and managed hosting/colocation service. AP Technical's 2010 article said JT secured the Rue des Pres site as its fourth Jersey data centre, and Saradan describes the conversion into a 400-rack Tier 3 co-hosting data centre.
